title: Deliver the Offline-First News Reader
prompt: Build the full Level 4 news slice with Room source of truth, cursor paging, ETag refresh, DataStore settings, secure session refresh, bookmark outbox, WorkManager sync, conflicts, migrations, and layered tests.
successCriteria: Previously synchronized articles and bookmarks work offline.
Process death and duplicate delivery lose no accepted intent.
Paging, authentication, migrations, retries, and eventual convergence have deterministic evidence.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class NewsApplicationGraph { /* database, stores, network, repositories, scheduler */ }

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
